lead: Devendra Fadnavis is an Indian politician, born on 22 July 1970 in Nagpur.
As of 2026, he is 56 years old, and his birth date places him under the Cancer sign.
He has held the office of Member of Maharashtra Legislative Assembly and Chief Minister of Maharashtra.
This profile collects the Devendra facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Devendra Fadnavis — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Devendra Fadnavis was born on 22 July 1970 in Nagpur, and holds Indian nationality.
He received his education at Savitribai Phule Pune University.
He is recorded as speaking Marathi.

sections.heading: Devendra Fadnavis — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician and jurist as his occupations.

He has held the following offices: Member of Maharashtra Legislative Assembly (2009–present), Chief Minister of Maharashtra (2014–2019), Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra (2022–2024) and Chief Minister of Maharashtra (2024–present). He is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
He has taken part in World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2015, World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2018 and World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2023.

sections.heading: Devendra Fadnavis — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He is married to Amruta Fadnavis.
